subject: proposed successor O1 (candidate-axis permutation) with statistic S8
kind: audit only; no design, no preregistration, no threshold, no permutation choice, no seed list

evidence_sources: frozen build_cost_volume on random feature fields
Aggregation class with freshly randomised weights (not a checkpoint)
toy mechanisms written in this record

decision_basis: a plausible non-correspondence mechanism (atypical-slice latching) reproduces the O1/S8 signature under every permutation tested
Delta_P1 > 0 is produced by a cyclic translation, which is INSIDE the symmetry group G that destroyed GEOM-002

primary_question.question: does candidate-axis permutation identify geometric correspondence, or merely sensitivity to candidate-axis ordering?
primary_question.answer: merely sensitivity to candidate-axis ordering, and under P1 not even that -- it identifies whether the OUTPUT INDEX FOLLOWS THE CONTENT, which every content-driven operator does

symmetry_analysis.inherited_group_G: generated by (k,w) -> (k-s, w+s); V(k,w) = F(k-tau, w+tau)

stage_commutation_with_pi.soft_argmin: NO -- weights are attached to absolute indices
stage_commutation_with_pi.aggregation: NO in general; EXACT for any pointwise-in-k operator

symmetry_analysis.readout_identity: m(c o pi) = sum_k k p(pi(k)) = E_{j~p}[pi^-1(j)]
consequences: any content-following operator has its output moved by pi^-1, corresponding or not
m_pi is an EXPECTATION of pi^-1, pulled toward mean(pi^-1)=5.5 whenever p is not sharp

z_score_removes_gain_not_shape.measured: cost rescaling by 0.25x to 64x changes E_orig, Delta and the point prediction not at all

symmetry_analysis.correction_to_prior_audit: the prior audit's criterion R-D (statistic must be broken by a transformation outside G) is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT. S8 passes that screening test and is still not identifying.

A1_fixed_lag_shortcut.note: not even a distinct mechanism -- at this architecture the cost volume already performs the match, so lag-0 preference and match readout are the SAME FUNCTION; M_lag+0 and M_corr are numerically identical

A3_absolute_index_positional_bias.note: the ONE alternative O1 genuinely excludes; pi permutes content, not positions

A5_sharp_but_wrong.note: excluded by the ABSOLUTE-ERROR clause, not by Delta; M_lag+3 gives E_orig 2.662 but Delta_P1 +0.683..+1.290, so Delta alone would have passed it

A7_readout_interaction.note: z-score and softmax exactly equivariant; the readout is an AMPLIFIER of the design defect, converting pi into E[pi^-1]

A8_atypical_slice_latching.note: V[tau] is EXACTLY zero (3,525,120 cells) -- a degeneracy that never occurs in real stereo. Latching the most unusual slice finds it with no matching. A LeakyReLU stack has a kink at zero.

permutation_analysis.introduces_artificial_absolute_index_eff: not in the aggregation (positions unchanged); YES at the readout, which is the mechanism of the translation false-positive

labels_vs_positions.permute_labels: aggregation untouched; tests the readout only; no information about the aggregation
labels_vs_positions.permute_positions_P1: changes k-convolution neighbours AND relabels readout weights -- TWO EFFECTS CONFOUNDED
labels_vs_positions.permute_positions_with_inverse_P2: cancels the readout relabelling, leaves only the neighbourhood effect

permutation_analysis.P1_measures: does the output index follow the content
permutation_analysis.P2_measures: does the aggregation use candidate-axis neighbourhood structure

statistic_audit.but: non-invariance is trivial (soft-argmin weights pinned to absolute positions) and is necessary, not sufficient
statistic_audit.fatal_invariance: S8 is invariant across the class of pointwise-in-k operators -- it depends on the operator only through p, and p peaked at tau is achieved by matching, by atypical-slice latching, or by anything preferring the zero slice
statistic_audit.absolute_index_dependence: S8 measures output-follows-content, not geometric use; it excludes only pure index bias
threshold_rejection_reasons: the scale is set by pi and tau, not by the mechanism (observed range -0.559 to +5.855 for one pi and one mechanism)
systematic tau artifact: m_pi is pulled toward 5.5, so a fully disrupted model looks LEAST disrupted at tau ~ 5-6

the quantisation rationale does not apply: the z-score removes gain, and the limiting blur is E[pi^-1] averaging, MEASURED at 0.89-1.46 candidates for an IDEAL matcher -- the same size as the proposed threshold

counterexample_suite.verdict: NOT IDENTIFIABLE -- genuine correspondence and atypical-slice latching give materially the same observable prediction in every column under every permutation

null_and_control.null_hypothesis: Delta = 0, the output does not follow candidate content
null_and_control.permutation_arm_is: a PAIRED TREATMENT, not a null
null_and_control.random_aggregation_is: a FLOOR, and a degenerate one
null_and_control.why_the_floor_is_degenerate: the standardised profile is weakly peaked and m is pinned near the window centre in BOTH arms; it sits at zero for a FLATNESS reason, not a geometric-blindness reason
null_and_control.unit_of_inference: UNSPECIFIED; must be at least (checkpoint, pair, tau, pi) with pi as a RANDOM EFFECT
null_and_control.can_the_null_saturate: saturation is not the failure mode; the failure mode is that Delta's scale is arbitrary, set by pi and tau
null_and_control.max_rule_forbidden_proof: P(max over N below threshold) = (1-p)^N -> 0 for any null with mass p > 0; derived independently, not inherited from GEOM-002
null_and_control.gate_can_pass_and_fail: numerically yes; interpretably no -- a pass is reproduced by the mechanisms in the counterexample suite

changed: which slice sits at the zero-padded k boundary
the multiset of aggregated costs (for non-pointwise operators)
unchanged_contrary_to_intuition: z-score statistics for pointwise operators (exactly equivariant)
control_validity.why_not: profile peakedness and the E[pi^-1] blur live inside the pair and are not removed by pairing; and the k-axis zero padding means permutation changes boundary treatment

claim_ceiling.candidate_axis_ordering_dependence: YES under P1, but a translation inside G also produces it
claim_ceiling.candidate_axis_neighbourhood_dependence: YES under P2 only -- the only clean mechanism-specific reading available
claim_ceiling.highest_defensible: the trained aggregation's output depends on the ordering of NEIGHBOURING candidate slices -- it is not a pointwise function of each candidate slice independently (a P2 claim, not a P1 claim)
claim_ceiling.caveat_on_that_ceiling: close to vacuous: the aggregation IS five stacked 3x3x3 convolutions whose second dimension is the candidate axis; a low-EPE model making no use of candidate neighbourhoods would be the surprise
claim_ceiling.proposal_stated_ceiling: NOT SUPPORTED -- the illegitimate word is 'geometric'

methodological_defects: under-specification: pi, fixed-vs-random, single-vs-ensemble, and P1-vs-P2 all undefined; would be verdict D on its own, subsumed by C because the collapse is structural
designer contamination: O1/S8 is post-hoc; prior mention in an earlier diagnostic note is NOT independent preregistration; not load-bearing here only because the verdict is negative anyway

same three checkpoints: n=1 training recipe; three seeds bound seed-noise only; agreement is NOT replication; repeated inspection means any threshold is fitted to them; a surviving claim is a claim about those three artifacts
the synthetic degeneracy V[tau] == 0 exactly is load-bearing and unnatural, and is what mechanism A8 exploits
the frozen readout blurs the only sharp prediction available, by 0.89-1.46 candidates, comparable to the proposed threshold
Delta's sign is not interpretable and its scale is set by pi; neither is fixable by more samples

minimum_hard_stops_if_a_different_design.HS-SYM: pre-freeze; derive the symmetry group and verify non-invariance -- STRENGTHENED: must also verify the statistic is not invariant across the class of pointwise-in-k operators
minimum_hard_stops_if_a_different_design.HS-CEX: pre-freeze; EXECUTE the counterexample suite including atypical-slice latching; halt if any non-correspondence mechanism reproduces the signature
minimum_hard_stops_if_a_different_design.HS-PERM: pre-freeze; pi is an ensemble treated as a random effect; no single pi; translations and near-translations excluded by construction; P1/P2 declared with its hypothesis
minimum_hard_stops_if_a_different_design.HS-BLUR: pre-trained; the design's irreducible blur measured and shown SMALLER than the preregistered threshold (measured here at 0.89-1.46 candidates, so 1.0 fails)
minimum_hard_stops_if_a_different_design.HS-NULL-MATCH: pre-trained; a floor sitting at zero must be shown not to sit there for an unrelated reason
minimum_hard_stops_if_a_different_design.HS-CEILING: pre-freeze; highest defensible claim written first and checked against the counterexample suite

conditions_for_any_future_successor: escape the DEGENERACY, not just the group: on a translated self-pair 'find the match' and 'find the weird slice' are the same task because V[tau] is exactly zero
produce a POINT PREDICTION (m_pi = pi^-1(tau)) across a pi ensemble, not a direction; and show the irreducible blur is well below the predicted displacement (bar to beat: 0.89-1.46 candidates)
execute the counterexample suite at design time (HS-CEX); every defect found here took seconds and no checkpoint
state the claim in the vocabulary the design supports
never treat the three checkpoints as replications of training
if the first two cannot both be met, STOP and record the synthetic translated self-pair class as exhausted

atypical-slice latching reproduces the correspondence signature under every permutation tested
Delta_P2 = 0.000 exactly for every pointwise operator; -3.299 for an adjacency-user under reverse
Delta's sign flips across tau for the target mechanism (+5.855 to -0.559)
the random-weight floor for Delta_P1 is +0.015, for a flatness reason
the point prediction is missed by 0.89-1.46 candidates even by an ideal matcher
the z-score removes global gain exactly (0.25x to 64x rescaling changes nothing)
established_derived: lag-0 preference and match readout are the same function at this architecture
A(V o pi) = A(V) o pi exactly for any pointwise-in-k operator, so no choice of pi separates two pointwise mechanisms
P1 and P2 test different hypotheses and the proposal does not say which is meant
non-invariance under G is necessary but not sufficient for identification
a max-over-null rule is forbidden by (1-p)^N, independently of GEOM-002

whether the trained model uses candidate neighbourhoods at all (prior probability high, evidence zero)
